gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns an unproved quantitative C(H1) norm estimate in a continuity lemma. ISSUE-001 instead diagnoses an incorrect pressure formula for a force perturbation in a numerical Stokes example; the two defects involve different mathematical objects and failed obligations.

The gold issue is a sign-convention error in the C0 interior-penalty boundary consistency term, which invalidates a discrete consistency premise. ISSUE-001 concerns differentiation of a pressure increment against a force perturbation in a separate numerical example, with no recognition of the boundary sign or consistency defect.

Both entries identify the same incorrect exact pressure increment: differentiating the printed formula yields -10^5 x_1^{-2.49}, not the prescribed 10^5 x_1^{-0.49}. Both also provide the corrected pressure increment (10^5/0.51)x_1^0.51, so the full substantive defect and repair are explicitly covered.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The asserted pressure change is not an antiderivative of the added gradient force, so the numerical benchmark states the wrong exact pressure and must replace it by (10^5/0.51)x_1^0.51, up to an additive constant.

component_coverage.gold_component: The printed pressure increment is mathematically inconsistent with the stated force perturbation, and the corrected antiderivative is (10^5/0.51)x_1^0.51 up to an additive constant.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly checks the gradient of the claimed pressure formula, shows the exponent and sign mismatch, supplies the correct antiderivative, and states that the numerical pressure formula is false.
